notes: Company snapshot: mid-market B2B SaaS (workflow automation for enterprise ops). Primary product is a conversational assistant inside product and an internal doc search feature.
Goals: adopt Hosted API quickly to ship Q2 feature; evaluate Dedicated for Q3 to reduce unit cost and meet EU residency contractual terms.

POC constraints: must keep embeddings/data and logs stored in EU region only, per contract w/ top 10 EU customers. They will not accept cross-region log routing without explicit encryption and residency controls.
Tech preference: model-agnostic approach — lean open-models preferred, but will accept Redwood-curated variants. Interested in quantized footprints for Dedicated to keep costs predictable.

Latency/throughput: target median p95-generation latency <100ms for chat token step in EU; bulk-embedding throughput target 4k req/min during nightly sync windows. Cost sensitivity: high — want predictable committed price for Dedicated with burst options.
Security ask (quote from CISO): 'We need clear guarantees: where embeddings live, who can access KMS, and audit trails for any cross-region failover.'

Routing/regions: ask for multi-region routing policy docs — want primary EU region with fallback to NA only if explicit business continuity event; need configurable routing policies per customer segment.

Proof points requested: Redwood to share EU performance profile, historical failover SLAs, and a sample Dedicated capacity plan. Also want a pricing workbook comparing hosted vs 3-year Dedicated commit under their expected QPS.
